Chapter 6652: I Alone Am Unbeatable

Chapter 6652: I Alone Am Unbeatable

“Enough talk, it’s time to fight.” Supreme Black Ancestor declared.

“Brother, let the children play first.” Weizhen said and waved.

“March!” Six-headed God roared and a dark flame surged in the form of a gigantic dragon. It looked to be as big as the cosmic avatar.

Space seemed incapable of containing its existence. One layer shattered after another.

Only emperors and up could witness the fight.

“Damn!” One blurted after seeing the fiery dragon. Its flames alone could wipe out regions in Three Immortals.

“Firmament Seal!” He ordered the dragon to rush toward the cosmic avatar.

The dragon wrapped around the target like a thin and long black silk. Several layers stacked up despite the avatar’s monstrous size.

The stars making up the being could no longer be seen. Not a single gap was present as the dragon tightened, attempting to crush it.

Stars and galaxies became powder during the onslaught, leaving the internal frame vulnerable to dark flames.

The other two legions immediately joined the battle. Tunshi retreated to the center of Dingtian Legion and summoned a pot.

“Dingtian stands alone, extinguish!” Its mouth opened like a blood-soaked jaw as it initiated a formational maelstrom.

The maelstrom flew above the cosmic avatar and started sucking everything. Three Immortals World was affected as well, shaking violently. If it had appeared closer, living beings would have been sucked in and crushed to nothingness. Primal ancestors stood no chance, let alone regular cultivators.

“Clank!” One Move Sword Saint also joined with his Poye Legion.

They somehow melted into space and disappeared, leaving behind a single light shining brighter than the suns and stars. This turned out to be the snow-white glint of a blade - the combination of the legion’s powers and murderous intents concentrated on a supreme grand dao. It pierced through space, hoping to deliver the finishing blow.

Dugu Yuan’s expression changed because he couldn’t nullify this attack using his variation.

“Night Piercer!” A mantra could be heard. This was Poye Legion’s ultimate formation, putting an end to numerous top cultivators during Nightwatch.

It only took a second for the cosmic being to be assaulted on three fronts. Everyone watched in awe since the legions carried out the assault immaculately.

“I alone am unbeatable.” A voice came from within the cosmic being.
